items.heading: Each Lane Has a Different
items.text: Each lane has a different entry step, a different speed to first pay, and a different ceiling. The lanes are listed from the highest income ceiling to the most structured, and none of them is good or bad in itself. Each one trades speed, ceiling and risk differently.

items.heading: The Same Lane Looks Different
items.text: The same lane looks different depending on where you stand today. A pre-final-year student can test cheaply.

items.heading: The Order Follows How Far
items.text: The order follows how far income can realistically grow with skill and proof, not prestige or exam difficulty. Consulting leads because you set the price, even though it is the slowest to start. Government sits last because its pay bands are fixed, and it is still a fine choice for the right person: stable pay is a real benefit.

visuals.heading: A Further Degree Is Worth

figures.label: Education Budget
figures.source: A further degree is worth its cost only if it does at least one of three things: raises your income ceiling, gives access you cannot get otherwise, or sharpens your positioning. A weak profile does not become strong just because the degree is expensive. Test the subject first through free material such as NPTEL , which is run by the IITs and IISc with learning free and an optional Rs 1,000 proctored certification exam.
